subjects.label: Beer and getting drunk
subjects.description: Drinking beer at the bar, the drinks and their effects, playing drunk and jokes about alcoholism; being unable to stop playing the game itself does not belong here.

subjects.label: Rock and Stone and the salute
subjects.description: The salute and its catchphrases, Rock and Stone and For Karl, used as a greeting, a sign-off or a running joke; remarks about how friendly the players are belong under community instead.

subjects.label: Being a dwarf
subjects.description: The dwarves themselves, their height, beards, hairiness and screaming, and the joke of playing as a short bearded miner; what the classes do in a team belongs under classes and team roles.

subjects.label: Working for the company
subjects.description: Role-playing an employee of the mining corporation: Mission Control as the boss, promotions, not turning up for work, forklift certification and workplace safety; the digging itself belongs under mining and digging.

subjects.label: Mining and digging
subjects.description: Digging through caves and mining minerals as the core activity, pickaxes, and comparisons with real miners and mining towns; the fiction of being on the company payroll belongs under working for the company.

subjects.label: Molly, Steeve, Lloyd and the crew
subjects.description: The non-player companions and staff: Molly, Steeve, Lloyd the bartender, Mission Control and the robot teammate for solo play; the creatures fought in the caves belong under the bugs.

subjects.label: The bugs
subjects.description: The alien creatures fought in the caves, swarms, named species such as the acid spreader or Q'ronor Shellback, and which enemies players want removed; a named pet or companion belongs under the crew.

subjects.label: Classes and team roles
subjects.description: The four classes, Gunner, Driller, Engineer and Scout, what each brings and whether every role matters to the team; complaints about the guns without reference to a class belong under gameplay.
